Usage: agy [options] [command]
Options:
  --input-format <format>  Input: text, stream-json
  --output-format <format> Output: text, json, stream-json
  --model <id>             Selected native model
  --conversation <id>      Resume exact conversation
  --print-timeout <value>  Bound headless run
  --project <id>           Project selection
  --new-project            New project selection
  --add-dir <path>         Additional workspace
  --agent <id>             Native agent
  --sandbox                Enable terminal sandbox
  --dangerously-skip-permissions  Explicit permission bypass
  --mode <mode>            Agent mode
  --log-file <path>        Diagnostics path
Commands:
  models                   List native models
  --future-adornment      Additive test flag
